subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be exposed by automatically grouping existing mediaUrls when eligible, by adding an explicit album/send-media-group action or parameter, or deferred in favor of current sequential sends?
rationale: The request adds user-visible Telegram message-tool behavior across multiple delivery surfaces, and the current linked draft chooses a new action shape that may not be the maintainers' preferred permanent API.

options.title: Group existing mediaUrls when eligible
options.body: Use the current durable mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only for Telegram-groupable media sets, falling back to sequential sends otherwise.

options.title: Adopt an explicit album action
options.body: Port or redesign the linked draft PR's explicit send-media-group/filePaths action if albums should be opt-in rather than automatic.

options.title: Defer album grouping
options.body: Keep current sequential media delivery and document that Telegram albums are not yet supported.

recommendation.title: Group existing mediaUrls when eligible
recommendation.body: Use the current durable mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only for Telegram-groupable media sets, falling back to sequential sends otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing signal from the prior cleanup review and current blame on the central Telegram files.
